name: draftkings api
description: DraftKings Pick6 lines and line history, DFS salaries, contests and slates, sportsbook moneylines, spreads and totals, native sportsbook scopes and ESPN box scores. Independent, not affiliated with or endorsed by DraftKings. Source scope and clocks are explicit. Every list route takes cursor (pagination.next_cursor); offset paging still works up to row 10,100. Retained rows are returned by default and labeled with stale and age_seconds. Only a delivered 2xx spends credits: each page costs its endpoint's credits per started 100 rows (GET /api/v1/credit-costs), and invalid queries, unavailable datasets and 304s cost nothing. New monthly plans: Free 100 credits/month (20 requests/minute), Developer 10,000 credits/month (60 requests/minute), Production 50,000 credits/month (120/minute). Legacy accounts retain original daily terms. Limits are shared across account keys.
